site_audit.platform: WordPress 7.1.4, hello-elementor theme 3.5.1, Elementor 4.4.0 + Elementor Pro (pro-elements 4.3.2), ElementsKit Lite 4.0.9, Essential Addons for Elementor Lite 6.8.8, TablePress 3.4.1, All in One SEO (AIOSEO) 5.0.4, locally-hosted Google Fonts (roboto, robotoslab, poppins, intertight), Elementor post CSS 6 / 15347 / 8840, plus a custom interactive-India-map plugin
site_audit.html_errors: 158 errors (155 HTML), 5 warnings, 146 info on the homepage. The most serious finding is structural: a complete second HTML document - doctype, <html lang="en">, <head>, <meta charset="UTF-8">, viewport and a <title> - is embedded inside the body at source line 417, shipped by the India-map plugin. That single defect produces the checker's 'Stray doctype', 'Stray start tag html', 'Stray start tag head', 'A charset attribute on a meta element found after the first 1024 bytes', 'A document must not include more than one meta element with a charset attribute', 'Element title not allowed as child of element div', 'Stray end tag head / div', 'Start tag body seen but an element of the same type was already open', 'End tag for body seen, but there were unclosed elements' and 'Unclosed element div (5) / header' errors. The rest are 7 'style element in body must be the first child of its parent', 121 style rules outside an @scope rule, a stray @import in a body style element, 5 role=group children of role=list, and 4 duplicate IDs on loop-dynamic-12687.

issues: A complete second HTML document is embedded inside your homepage body: the checker finds a doctype, <html lang="en">, <head>, <meta charset="UTF-8">, a viewport meta and a <title> at source line 417. Your India-map plugin ships its own whole page inside yours.

All four of your hero counters read zero - 'Energy audits 0+', 'Carbon reduction projects 0+', 'Renewable projects supported 0 GW' and 'Net Zero projects completed 0+' - on a page that separately claims 180+ major projects across 28 states and 8 union territories.
The checker reports 158 errors on the homepage, more than any other site in this audit, and 121 of them are style rules sitting outside an @scope rule.
You are running 9 live Google ads - the highest count of any lead in this audit - and the ad destination is a page whose head carries no conversion tracking that could be confirmed in this pass.
There is no price list anywhere on the site, so every enquiry arrives without a number attached to it.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic

promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 9 live ads under advertiser AR02278013072834560001, verified as ZENITH ENERGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED, including a YouTube video creative.

The site behind those 9 ads carries 158 HTML errors on the homepage, a complete second HTML document embedded in the body, and four hero counters that all read zero. The ad buys the click; the page has to carry it.
The advertiser's service pages promise ESCO retrofits, energy audits, solar, water management and net-zero programmes for industries and businesses across India.

The homepage substantiates the ESCO claim (an empanelled ESCO with the Bureau of Energy Efficiency) and names three real case studies - Basavatarakam Indo American Cancer Hospital, a clean-cooking project in Koraput, Odisha, and a net-zero roadmap for VPCL Visakha Pharmacity - plus a client carousel. But there is no price list, no published capacity figure and no case-study metric, so a prospect cannot size the offer from the page.
The site positions Zenith as a national net-zero consultancy with 180+ major projects across 28 states and 8 union territories.

The India map that carries those numbers also carries the structural defect: its plugin ships a whole second HTML document inside the homepage body. The interactive widget is the most distinctive asset on the page and it is also the largest single source of validation errors.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
